laws.rule: Adults 21 and over may carry up to 2 ounces of marijuana; public consumption is prohibited, with a civil penalty of up to USD 100. Cannabis remains illegal under US federal law, including on federal land such as national parks.

You need a Massachusetts firearms licence to possess or carry a firearm; non-residents apply for a one-year non-resident licence to carry through the Firearms Records Bureau (new applicants need a Massachusetts safety course certificate). Non-residents may not buy firearms there.

items.text: Adults 21 and over, including out-of-state visitors with government-issued ID, may buy from licensed retailers and carry up to 2 ounces (10 ounces at home). No consumption in public places or on federal land, or wherever tobacco smoking is banned; the civil penalty is up to US$100 (about A$142 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). An open container in a vehicle's passenger area carries up to US$500. Taking cannabis across state lines or mailing it is illegal.
